lens: Identity, evidence status, authorization and mutation recovery

findings.criterion: Write integrity under an unknown result
findings.observation: The assembled creation card can create a second Person after a real 201 receipt is lost and the note is edited. Pi's first unknown-result patch is not integrated; review also found unvalidated receipts and stale-scope continuation.
findings.evidence: Artifact 9938d394; evidence/create-lost-response-duplicate.json records two distinct Person IDs; frontend-third-review.txt in the private task evidence holds code-review reproduction points.
findings.user_impact: One human intent becomes two identities and fragmented source history, with uncertain ownership and no reliable recovery.
findings.recommendation: Keep exact immutable request/scope state until a matching receipt resolves it; block stale workspace continuations and warn before discarding recovery.
findings.verification: Lost-201 browser retry returns the original identity/resource; malformed/wrong-scope receipts and unmount/account races cause no new intent or follow-up write.

findings.observation: The resident relationship route rejects unchanged proposed evidence late. The local repair consistently excludes it from the reviewed manifest, while its final revocation check still passes the negative tests.
findings.user_impact: A normal pending-review state becomes a misleading conflict after provider work; users may repeatedly retry without understanding why.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the reviewed fix and repeat the affected real-browser journey before closing EXP-13.
findings.verification: Unchanged proposed evidence does not appear in reviewed model context and no longer triggers a fictitious source-change result; revoked evidence still blocks completion.

strengths: Source and Memory remain separate: imported unconfirmed source did not populate accepted Person Memory.
Source revision conflicts refresh once and require another explicit decision; deletion consent is reset.
missing_evidence: EXP-11 integrated code and real-backend retry acceptance.
Current runtime deployment/readback of EXP-09 and EXP-13.
Full derived-store and external integration deletion/reversal acceptance.
vetoes: Unknown-save recovery can duplicate a Person
